name: Lotry
description: An on-chain lottery round. Tickets are NFTs, the pot is a covenant nobody can take, and the winner is drawn from a committed secret.

resources.name: Lotry.fun
resources.description: The original Lotry, a tokenized lottery on Base (Base Batch India 2025 runner-up). This template migrates its core round to Bitcoin Cash.

resources.name: Original contracts
resources.description: The Solidity contracts this round is migrated from.

organiser.name: Organiser
organiser.description: Opens a round, keeps the secret that decides the winner, and reveals it at the draw. Can never spend the pot.

player.name: Player
player.description: Buys tickets, and claims the pot with the winning ticket or gets the ticket price back if the round is never drawn.

openRound.name: Open a round
openRound.description: Create the pot of a new lottery round with its own ticket category.

buyTicket.name: Buy a ticket
buyTicket.description: Pay the ticket price into the pot and receive the next numbered ticket NFT.

drawRound.name: Draw the winner
drawRound.description: Reveal the round secret after the draw height and write the winning ticket number into the pot.

claimPot.name: Claim the pot
claimPot.description: Spend the drawn pot with the winning ticket. Both NFTs are burned and the whole pot is paid out.

refundTicket.name: Refund a ticket
refundTicket.description: After the refund height, if the round was never drawn, burn a ticket and get its price back from the pot.

openRoundTransaction.name: Round opened
openRoundTransaction.description: A Lotry round opened: tickets cost $(<ticketPrice>) satoshis, the draw is from block $(<drawHeight>).

drawRoundTransaction.name: Winner drawn
drawRoundTransaction.description: Ticket #$(winningTicketNumber) won the pot of $(<potSatoshis>) satoshis.

claimPotTransaction.name: Pot claimed
claimPotTransaction.description: The winning ticket #$(<winningTicket>) claimed the pot.

potDrawInput.name: Round pot
potDrawInput.description: The pot when the winner is drawn.

potRefundInput.name: Round pot
potRefundInput.description: The undrawn pot after the refund height.

ticketClaimInput.name: Winning ticket
ticketClaimInput.description: Ticket #$(<winningTicket>), burned to claim the pot.

potOpenedOutput.name: Round pot
potOpenedOutput.description: A new round with no tickets sold yet.

potDrawnOutput.name: Drawn pot
potDrawnOutput.description: The pot waiting for ticket #$(winningTicketNumber) to claim it.

claimPayoutOutput.name: Lotry winnings
claimPayoutOutput.description: The whole pot, paid to the winner.

potLockingScript.name: Lotry pot
potLockingScript.description: A lottery pot that only pays the drawn winner, or refunds tickets if the round is never drawn.

ticketLockingScript.name: Lotry ticket
ticketLockingScript.description: A numbered ticket NFT held by its player.

scripts.winningTicketNumber: <roundSecret> OP_SHA256 <4> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP <0x00> OP_CAT OP_BIN2NUM <ticketCount> OP_MOD OP_1ADD
scripts.potCarriesOn: OP_0 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE OP_0 OP_UTXOBYTECODE OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENCATEGORY OP_EQUALVERIFY
scripts.output1HasNoToken: OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_1 OP_GREATERTHAN OP_IF OP_1 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_ENDIF
scripts.output2HasNoToken: OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_2 OP_GREATERTHAN OP_IF OP_2 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_ENDIF
scripts.potBuy:
potIsOpen
            OP_BIN2NUM OP_1ADD OP_4 OP_NUM2BIN
            OP_DUP OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_EQUALVERIFY
            OP_1 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_EQUALVERIFY
            potCarriesOn
            OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_0 OP_UTXOVALUE <ticketPrice> OP_ADD OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
            OP_1 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY roundCategoryOnly OP_EQUALVERIFY
            OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_3 OP_LESSTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY
            output2HasNoToken
scripts.potDraw:
<drawHeight> OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY OP_DROP
            OP_DUP OP_SHA256 <secretHash> OP_EQUALVERIFY
            potIsOpen
            OP_BIN2NUM OP_DUP OP_0 OP_GREATERTHAN OP_VERIFY
            OP_SWAP OP_SHA256 <4> OP_SPLIT OP_DROP <0x00> OP_CAT OP_BIN2NUM
            OP_SWAP OP_MOD OP_1ADD
            OP_4 OP_NUM2BIN <0xd0> OP_CAT
            OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_EQUALVERIFY
            potCarriesOn
            OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_0 OP_UTXOVALUE OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
            OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_2 OP_LESSTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY
            output1HasNoToken
scripts.potClaim:
potIsDrawn
            OP_4 OP_SPLIT <0xd0> OP_EQUALVERIFY
            OP_1 OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_EQUALVERIFY
            input1IsTicket
            OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_2 OP_LESSTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY
            OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCATEGORY OP_0 OP_EQUALVERIFY
            output1HasNoToken
scripts.potRefund:
<refundHeight> OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY OP_DROP
            potIsOpen OP_DROP
            input1IsTicket
            potCarriesOn
            OP_0 OP_OUTPUTTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_0 OP_UTXOTOKENCOMMITMENT OP_EQUALVERIFY
            OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_0 OP_UTXOVALUE <ticketPrice> OP_SUB OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
            OP_TXOUTPUTCOUNT OP_3 OP_LESSTHANOREQUAL OP_VERIFY
            output1HasNoToken
            output2HasNoToken
scripts.potRedeem:
OP_INPUTINDEX OP_0 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY
            OP_DUP OP_1 OP_NUMEQUAL OP_IF OP_DROP potBuy OP_ELSE
            OP_DUP OP_2 OP_NUMEQUAL OP_IF OP_DROP potDraw OP_ELSE
            OP_DUP OP_3 OP_NUMEQUAL OP_IF OP_DROP potClaim OP_ELSE
            OP_4 OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY potRefund
            OP_ENDIF OP_ENDIF OP_ENDIF
            OP_1

ticketSatoshis.name: Ticket dust
ticketSatoshis.description: Satoshis carried by each ticket NFT output.

minerFeeSatoshis.name: Payout fee
minerFeeSatoshis.description: Fee taken from the payout when a pot is claimed or a ticket refunded.

ticketPrice.name: Ticket price
ticketPrice.description: Satoshis paid into the pot for one ticket.

drawHeight.name: Draw height
drawHeight.description: Block height from which the winner can be drawn.

refundHeight.name: Refund height
refundHeight.description: Block height from which tickets of an undrawn round can be refunded.

secretHash.name: Secret hash
secretHash.description: SHA-256 of the organiser secret that decides the winner.

roundSecret.name: Round secret
roundSecret.description: The organiser secret, revealed at the draw.

roundCategory.name: Round category
roundCategory.description: Token category of this round: the pot NFT and every ticket.

seedSatoshis.name: Seed
seedSatoshis.description: Satoshis the organiser puts in the pot when opening it.

potSatoshis.name: Pot
potSatoshis.description: Satoshis in the pot right now.

potCommitment.name: Pot state
potCommitment.description: The pot NFT commitment: the ticket count (openCommitment), or the winner (drawnCommitment).

nextPotCommitment.name: Next pot state
nextPotCommitment.description: The pot NFT commitment after this action: nextOpenCommitment for a ticket, drawnCommitment for a draw.

ticketCommitment.name: Ticket number
ticketCommitment.description: The new ticket NFT commitment: the 4-byte ticket number (nextOpenCommitment).

ticketCount.name: Tickets sold
ticketCount.description: Tickets sold so far in this round.

winningTicket.name: Winning ticket
winningTicket.description: The ticket number written into the pot at the draw.

ticketNumber.name: Ticket number
ticketNumber.description: The number of the ticket being refunded.

payoutLockingScript.name: Pay to
payoutLockingScript.description: Where the winnings or the refund go.

playerKey.name: Player key
playerKey.description: The key that holds a player's tickets.
